Class ResourceHostContextFactory

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.ui.resourcedist.ResourceHostContextFactory
public final class ResourceHostContextFactory extends Object
Host context factory and UI metric helper for ResourceDistributionPanel.

Extracted in accordance with the Single Responsibility Principle (SRP) to construct callback bridges for all Tab 2 domain builders (geology, hydrography, biome, climate, preview canvas, preset manager, planet inheritance, and GIS export) without polluting the root ResourceDistributionPanel layout class.

Version:
1.0.0-beta.3
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
